notes.title: 🎉 Box-Pushing Fest 2025 is live! Roku and Rei is 50% Off until April 28! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey puzzle lovers! 💙❤️
Roku and Rei is taking part in the Steam Box-Pushing Fest, with a 50% discount available until April 28.


 In this puzzle game, you control two characters who move together in mirrored directions.
 Every move requires precision, and each puzzle challenges your sense of symmetry and logic.
 A free demo is available if you'd like to give it a try.
 The full game includes over 100 levels, featuring a wide range of mechanics to discover and master.
 If you enjoy designing puzzles as much as solving them, there’s also a built-in editor that lets you create and share your own levels.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035491/0087508fc00b40509893acaa00a94f007c066c84.png

Solve clever puzzles, master the symmetry, and put your logic to the test.

Now’s a great time to jump in!
Happy puzzling! 🧩

notes.title: 🎉 Join the Official Roku and Rei Discord Channel! 🎉
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We’re excited to announce the launch of the Roku and Rei Discord channel! 🎮✨
You can join it by clicking on the discord icon below!

Join us to:
- Share your custom levels.
- Get the latest news and updates.
- Provide feedback and suggestions.
- Ask questions and get support from the community and developers.
- Share memes!

We hope you enjoy your time there!
Happy puzzling! 🧩

notes.title: Roku and Rei - Patch Notes - Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Patch Notes - Version 1.0.1

We’re happy to announce the first update for Roku and Rei!
This update includes two changes:
[olist]
Alternative Wins Appearance
Workshop and Subscribed Menu Improvements
[/olist]
Alternative Wins Appearance
You can now change the appearance of the wins in-game by going to Settings > Graphics > Alternative Wins.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035491/c7d5648076a3cd8c6899996e920400ca80acb43d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035491/e7c2b928f1a75cf077caf7a9f64ce932852ed68d.png

Workshop and Subscribed Menu Improvements

When selecting/hovering a filter from the bottom bar in the Workshop and Subscribed menus, a yellow title now indicates what the filter does.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035491/b14550414bcb020be80d98166b6073f4a93d97e6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035491/d92b9094d867320cb1f20af97c58fc1dd3751d11.png

Thank you for your support and feedback!

notes.title: Roku and Rei is OUT NOW 🎉🎉
notes.content:
Dear Players, 🎮

We are thrilled to announce that Roku and Rei, is now available! 🎉

Dive into the world of Roku and Rei, a puzzle game where the protagonists move in reverse directions! 
Use their ability to interact with color-coded objects and tackle mind-bending challenges.

Game content

 Over 100 levels with various mechanics and objects.
 An integrated level editor.
 Worshop integration for uploading and downloading levels directly withing the game.
 Over 30 achievements to unlock!

[previewyoutube=p_Ar6KuDt0s;full][/previewyoutube]
We can't wait to see how you will venture into the game and hear your impressions!
Join our community to share your experiences, suggestions and feedbacks.

Roku and Rei are awaiting for you!

Happy puzzling! 🧩
